title: Inspect, Monitor, and Copy Files
description: Practice docker inspect, docker stats, docker top, and docker cp to manage a container.
problemStatement:
## Objective
Use inspection and monitoring tools to diagnose a running container, and practice file transfers.

### Steps
1. Run an Nginx container in detached mode:
   ```bash
   docker run -d --name web-server -p 8080:80 nginx:alpine
   ```
2. Inspect the container and extract its IP address using `--format`:
   ```bash
   docker inspect -f '{{.NetworkSettings.IPAddress}}' web-server
   ```
3. Inspect to see the environment variables set inside:
   ```bash
   docker inspect -f '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' web-server
   ```
4. Monitor its resource usage with a single snapshot:
   ```bash
   docker stats --no-stream web-server
   ```
5. List the running processes inside the container:
   ```bash
   docker top web-server
   ```
6. Copy the default `index.html` file from the container to your host:
   ```bash
   docker cp web-server:/usr/share/nginx/html/index.html ./nginx-index.html
   ```
   Open it in a text editor to verify.
7. Modify the file on your host (add a comment), then copy it back into the container:
   ```bash
   echo "<!-- Hello from host -->" >> nginx-index.html
   docker cp nginx-index.html web-server:/usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
   ```
8. Refresh `http://localhost:8080` – the source code may not visually change, but the file inside should have the comment. Verify with:
   ```bash
   docker exec web-server cat /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
   ```
9. Stop and remove the container.
hints: The IP address will be something like 172.17.0.2. It’s a private IP on the Docker bridge network.
When copying files back, ensure the destination path includes the filename, not just the directory.
expectedOutput: The IP address is printed. The `docker stats` snapshot shows memory/CPU usage. The copied file exists locally. After copying back, `cat` inside shows the comment.
solutionCode:
docker run -d --name web-server -p 8080:80 nginx:alpine
docker inspect -f '{{.NetworkSettings.IPAddress}}' web-server
docker inspect -f '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' web-server
docker stats --no-stream web-server
docker top web-server
docker cp web-server:/usr/share/nginx/html/index.html ./nginx-index.html
echo "<!-- Hello from host -->" >> nginx-index.html
docker cp nginx-index.html web-server:/usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
docker exec web-server cat /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
docker stop web-server
docker rm web-server
